items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And we had Charlie Smith come out to play drums.

ctx.x: So we went on to the Oasis, the club in Frisco -- and, by the way, when Johnny left we sent to Kansas City and got one of the Douglas brothers. They were saxophone players in Kansas City, good saxophone players, but it wasn't really what Duke wanted.
And we had Charlie Smith come out to play drums.
Well, Charlie Smith was a nervous wreck, and Duke's band liked to have run him crazy because he didn't know what to do.
